title: Substrate
definition: The layer of structured records, one per ADR, invariant, pattern, vocabulary term, scenario, or other governance unit, that carries audit-substance (thresholds, felt-trigger phrasings, rejected alternatives, graduation triggers) and provenance via Typed Links. Agent-facing primarily; human-readable via Surface Views. Treated as a first-class auditable layer (C1). Record shape is per type, not universal; the type set is extensible (C4). Whether the Substrate or the source ADRs are canonical is held open for DECIDE. Need not be a stored graph artifact (GraphReader 2024): the navigational scaffolding, not the storage form, carries the gain.
product_origin: "a graph behind a human-friendly format" (Solo Developer, research log §Step 1.4); "good for agent context"
aliases: KG (the practitioner's candidate; the Substrate need not be a stored graph)
